ns2:course.label: Seminar in Women's Studies
ns2:course.description: Interdisciplinary seminar on special topics in women's studies 3 undergraduate hours. 2 to 4 graduate hours. May be repeated one time if topics vary. Prerequisite: GWS 250 or GWS 260, and two courses in Gender and Women's Studies at the 200-300 levels; junior standing; or consent of instructor.
